Part 1: Lists
Storing groups of data together in

Lists
List: A data structure that stores multiple values in a specific order within
a single variable.
Lists are useful when working with large amounts of similar or related
data.
Lists are iterables, meaning they can easily be iterated over.
Iterating over a list allows you to perform some kind of computation using
every element of the list, with relatively little code.
